remaining_work.detail: The current results use T-120. Separate as-of source bindings, contexts and a verified fitting/inference path are required before T-60 results can be claimed.
The current census contains 755 completed and 133 pending games. An empty postseason response does not certify the complete official population.
Extra Trees and LightGBM source ablations remain preserved; XGBoost and CatBoost now add 204 policy variants. Other family and mode cells have not been registered.
Additional learned layers require predeclared forward-fold recipes. 2026 outcomes cannot tune those layers.
Arithmetic point blends do not define a predictive mixture distribution or justify CRPS.
Both authentic endpoints need qualified pregame bindings.
Kalshi, Polymarket Global and Polymarket US need authenticated as-of routes, exact contract adapters and source rights.
Play, drive, injury, replacement, weather, travel, coaching and historical event-response input bindings remain unfinished.
Ten pending-game feature rows remain missing for each target. Missing rows stay visible and do not shrink the fixture manifest.
These exposed frozen reconstructions cannot establish previously unproved original pregame issuance.
